source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Clearly indicate the model number and serial number of the appliance being tested.
3. Record the date and time of the safety check using the organization’s standard format.
4. Note the location where the test was performed.
5. List the individual or qualification of the person conducting the test.
6. Document the electrical test meter or equipment type and calibration date.
7. Identify the specific safety checks performed (e.g., earth continuity, insulation resistance, leakage current, etc.).
8. Record the readings and any observed defects or failure during the checks. 
9. Use a checklist to ensure that all required safety checks have been performed and documented.
10. Include any additional notes or comments regarding anomalous behavior or visual inspections.
11. Clearly label the failed items within the report with detailed explanations of the reasons for failure.
12. Provide pictures or diagrams where applicable, clearly labeling any defected components or areas.
13. Attach any internal or external reports, service
